currentPhase.description: M3.2 AI Kit Factory is promoted and M3.2.5 Factory Reliability is qualified on a real eight-domain benchmark: 8 distinct FactoryRuns, 6 PASS, 2 justified semantic HOLD, all required domains covered, zero human escalation, and PASS_FACTORY_BENCHMARK_V1. The learner runtime remains the exact promoted M2.2 artifact. M3.3 is only the next possible gate and remains HOLD pending fresh accountable-owner arbitration.

currentMain.description: Current main includes promoted M3.2/M3.2.5 factory reliability and the final bounded real-source snapshot infrastructure. Real benchmark qualification evidence is external/transient and was not merged as a repository corpus.

developmentBaseline.note: ATLAS-WP-018 authorizes arbitration and bounded design only. No M3.3 product implementation is authorized until that arbitration proves distinct value beyond the qualified M3.2/M3.2.5 AI Kit Factory.

promotedBaseline.candidate: Project Atlas M2.2 transfer + learner-facing clarity
promotedBaseline.note: Learner runtime baseline remains M2.2 unchanged by M3 authoring. M3.0/M3.1 authoring promotion is recorded separately under acceptedControls.

stageDOperatingModel.policy: disjoint development, independent QA, non-repairing integration and Governor decisions at contract, candidate and promotion boundaries

authorizedWork: Repository maintenance, canonical-state alignment and evidence-preserving closeout may proceed under bounded authority.
M3.2/M3.2.5 regression fixes may proceed only under a new bounded authority that preserves the promoted learner runtime and factory contracts.
heldWork: M3.3 assisted authoring remains HOLD pending fresh accountable-owner arbitration proving distinct value beyond the qualified M3.2/M3.2.5 AI Kit Factory.
M3.4 scale/publishing remains HOLD until separately authorized.
Generic Source-to-Draft, PDF/OCR/document normalization and intermediate draft schemas remain unneeded by current evidence and require a new evidence-backed decision if proposed.
Human graphical/contextual author-review debt #272 remains deferred and non-blocking until human review becomes a first-class workflow.
Gate 3 repository-write capability remains HOLD unless separately authorized.
Gate 4 parallel runtime remains HOLD unless separately authorized.
M4 Learn-it Everywhere, backend, accounts, cloud synchronization, remote catalog, commerce, tenancy and marketplace remain HOLD.
Teacher, cohort and institutional features remain HOLD before explicit later-milestone authority.
prohibitedWork: runtime LLM, remote AI API, embedded secret or network-required learning behavior without explicit future authority
direct write to main outside the repository's enforced governed pull-request process
silent product repair by an integration or QA lane in a product-owner file
destructive migration or reuse of protected RC718 storage
claiming certification, durable mastery or retention beyond observed evidence
publishing an artifact different from the exact artifact tested and promoted
embedding M3 authoring or LLM assistance code into the learner runtime artifact

activeRisks.statement: Human review of AI-authored kits lacks a sequence-level graphical/contextual overview; tracked as non-blocking debt #272.
activeRisks.closureGate: Close or supersede issue #272 only after a separately authorized human-review workflow provides sequence-level context and passes its own evidence gate.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Before any M3.3 product implementation, challenge whether Assisted Authoring is still a distinct useful milestone now that M3.2/M3.2.5 already support AI authoring, repair, independent semantic review and deterministic PASS/HOLD. If justified, create a bounded authority; otherwise skip or redefine M3.3.

review.lastReviewedBy: Permanent Governor after M3.2 promotion and M3.2.5 real eight-domain qualification
review.nextReviewTrigger: fresh M3.3 accountable-owner arbitration, M3.2/M3.2.5 regression, source-ingestion proposal, model/vendor integration proposal, human UX debt #272 reactivation, Gate3/Gate4 request or M4+ proposal
